hints.title: Check Character Pairs
hints.text: A string is nice if for every letter present, its opposite case counterpart is also present.

hints.title: Divide and Conquer on Invalid Letters
hints.text: Find any character c whose opposite case counterpart is missing from the entire string.

hints.title: Split and Recurse
hints.text: Any nice substring cannot contain this character; split the string by this invalid character and recurse on pieces.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all O(n^2) substrings naively is O(n^3).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Divide and conquer splits at most 26 times across distinct characters in O(26n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses divide and conquer splitting around characters that lack case counterparts.

solutions.approach: Divide and conquer splitting around unpaired case characters
